senses.gloss:
आभरण आभरण, i. e. आ-भृ + अन, n. Ornaments, as jewels, etc., Rām. 3, 55, 6.
 --Comp.

आभा आ-भा, f.
 1. Splendour, light, Pañc. iv. d. 58.
 2. When latter part of a compound adj., often Like; e. g. Rām. 3, 55, 28, गिरि-शृङ्ग-आभ, Like the peak of a mountain.
 --Comp.
आभाष आ-भाष् + अ, m., and आभाषण आभाषण, i. e. आ-भाष् + अन n. Addressing, speaking to, Rām. 3, 26, 12; Rājat. 5, 462.

आभास आ-भास् + अ, m.
 1. Splendour, Rām. 6, 77, 17.
 2. Light, Vedāntas. [] in Chr. 219, 11.
 3. Appearance, Kathās. 12, 16.
 4. Semblance, Bhāṣāp. 70.
 --Comp.
अ-भय-दक्षिणा अ-भय-दक्षिणा, f. promise of security, Man. 4, 247.
अ- + भक्ष्य अ- + भक्ष्य, adj. unfit, or not allowed, to be eaten, Man. 1, 113.
अ- + भङ्गुर अ- + भङ्गुर, adj. 1. unbroken. 2. undisturbed, Rājat. 5, 4.
अ- + भद्र अ- + भद्र, adj. distressed, Bhāg. P. 4, 30, 28.

अ- + भय अ- + भय,
 I. n. 1. safety, Hit. i. d. 104, M.M. 2. protection from danger, Man. 4, 247. 3. the name of a Dvīpa, or division of the world. 4. a fragrant grass, Andropogon muricatum.
 II. adj., f. या, fearless, Bhartṛ. 3, 32.
 III. m. 1. epithet of Śiva. 2. a proper name.
 IV. f. या, a plant, Terminalia citrina, Suśr. 1, 139, 14.
अ- + भव अ- + भव, m. 1. nonexistence, Sāv. 3, 10. 2. cessation of existence, Rām. 3, 69, 9.

अ- + भाव अ- + भाव, m. 1. absence, Man. 8, 259; Hit. i. d. 118, M.M. 2. nonexistence; अभाव + तस्, adv. in consequence of the non-existence, Bhāṣāp. 113. 3. death, Kathās. 18, 270. 4. destruction, Rām. 5, 27, 6.
अ- + भाग अ- + भाग, adj. deprived of one's share, Man. 9, 213.
अ- + भाग्य अ- + भाग्य, adj. unfortunate, Pañc. 197, 23.
अ-भग्न-मान + म् अ-भग्न-मान + म्, adv. without injury to one's honour, Hit. ii. d. 41.
अ-भय- + वाच् अ-भय- + वाच्, f. promise of safety, Hit. 59, 2.
